architecture.summary: The SO-01b hosted image workflow becomes the release path (SO-02). Each push to main builds Dockerfile.hosted for linux/amd64, runs the hosted image gate on that image, and pushes it to GHCR by digest; a failed check or gate pushes nothing. Only a manual dispatch on main with a digest and a service ID deploys: the deploy job uses the repository secret RENDER_API_KEY (a dedicated Render user; no GitHub environment) for the Render API deploy with imageUrl, waits for live, and checks the image and /healthz. It refuses another branch, a service that is not an image-backed web service of Thermus AI, and production without confirm_production. deployment: a new delivery relationship from GitHub Actions to Render. crossCutting: the workflows of this repository get deploy authority over the Thermus AI workspace, production included. policy: each merge runs the hosted image gate. Production still builds from Git until step 5 of SO-12, so no C4 container, runtime relationship, contract, component, or Mermaid view changes; registry prose names the release path.
